response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose total scan duration is zero (rate undefined) get a NULL rate. They are left out of the benchmark average and the results, and no division-by-zero error is raised.
NULL gbsize or spanmin values are skipped by SUM, as is usual in SQL. Each group's total size and total duration are summed independently.
The benchmark is the unweighted average of group rates over all matched groups, computed before the strictly-above filter and the top-10 cut.
